Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.ConstraintSensitivityAssessment

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.ConstraintSensitivityAssessment
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator
public static final class ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.ConstraintSensitivityAssessment extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable qualification of one constraint-margin derivative with respect to one decision variable.

The assessment retains raw engineering units and is local to the sampled operating point. It is not a ranking, global sensitivity, KKT multiplier, economic shadow price, or process-safety approval.
